events.note: Born at Kamionna (PSB) or at Bieganowo (the database, after Dworzaczek).

Heir of Trąbczyn in a decree of 1766 (quoted in 1771), named heir and patron (kollator) in the decree of 1775-1776 and presenting the parish priest in 1785; the decree of 1784 adjudged him his uncles' whole paternal fortune.
Left for Italy in 1794 (the Warsaw memoir; PSB: at the end of 1794); at Venice in December 1796; left for Mantua in March 1797 (PSB).

events.type: Estates confiscated; Trąbczyn given to Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen
events.note: The royal approval of 9 August 1796; the confiscation sentence on Kolno is dated 27 June 1796.
"Died in 1803 in a foreign country" (the Prussian note of 1819). The Warsaw memoir of 1818 implies an earlier death, soon after his wife's; PSB and the database say about 1806.
